prompts.title: Moody Studio Portrait of Man with Halo Light
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic editorial portrait of a man in a dramatic black-and-white setup, using the uploaded reference image for accurate facial identity and facial structure.
Composition:
A vertical 4:5 portrait, medium close-up from the chest upward. The subject is positioned slightly right of center, with his body turned about three-quarter away from the camera while his head turns back toward the viewer. Strong, confident, serious expression with an intense direct gaze. Natural facial proportions, and thick neatly styled hair with realistic individual strands.
Outfit:
He wears a black leather jacket with a large raised collar. The leather should have highly realistic texture, stitching, folds, creases, and subtle specular highlights. The jacket dominates the lower portion of the frame.
Eyewear:
Slim, angular rectangular sunglasses with dark frames and deep translucent red/amber-tinted lenses. The eyes remain subtly visible through the lenses.
Background & Lighting:
A completely dark black studio background with a large, bright circular white light halo positioned directly behind his head and shoulders, creating a dramatic graphic silhouette. High-contrast monochrome lighting across the face and jacket, with carefully controlled highlights and deep shadows. The circular backlight should be perfectly clean and softly diffused around its edges.
Color Treatment:
Predominantly black and white / monochrome, while preserving only the sunglasses lenses in a subtle deep crimson-red tint. Rich blacks, bright whites, strong tonal separation, cinematic contrast.
Camera & Quality:
Eye-level camera angle, professional fashion-editorial photography, approximately 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, extremely sharp facial details, realistic skin pores and beard texture, detailed hair strands, realistic leather texture, subtle film grain, premium studio photography, dramatic cinematic atmosphere, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K quality.
